"""Regression tests for the newly authored text_metrics skill."""

from pathlib import Path

from ourob.skills.base import SkillContext
from ourob.skills.registry import SkillRegistry
from ourob.state.model import Invocation

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def _registry() -> SkillRegistry:
    registry = SkillRegistry(REPO)
    registry.discover()
    return registry


def test_text_metrics_is_discovered_by_a_fresh_registry() -> None:
    assert _registry().has("text_metrics")


def test_text_metrics_counts_deterministically() -> None:
    registry = _registry()
    context = SkillContext(repo=REPO, services={})
    result = registry.dispatch(
        Invocation(skill="text_metrics", args={"text": "one two\nthree"}), context
    )
    assert result.ok, result.error
    assert result.data == {"characters": 13, "words": 3, "lines": 2}
    assert result.output == "3 words, 2 lines"


def test_text_metrics_handles_empty_text() -> None:
    registry = _registry()
    context = SkillContext(repo=REPO, services={})
    result = registry.dispatch(Invocation(skill="text_metrics", args={"text": ""}), context)
    assert result.ok, result.error
    assert result.data == {"characters": 0, "words": 0, "lines": 0}
